case_1_breakdown.description: A priority van breaks down on route; standby non-priority van EV_009 is promoted with a 32 kWh mission and a 15:30 departure.

case_2_driver_unavailable.description: Driver absence delays priority van EV_050 by 2 h.

case_3_roster_swap.description: FMS swaps the afternoon route from priority EV_050 to non-priority EV_009; operator keeps all urgent vehicles.

case_4_pv_shortfall.description: Cloud front: realised PV falls to 25 % of the day-ahead forecast for 2 h.
